assessmentBoundary: JavaScript-compatible TypeScript module behavior only; no Harmony compiler, UI, emulator or device-performance claim.

checks.behavior: Add a premium policy with three attempts while preserving the standard one-attempt boundary.
Make a premium request succeed on its third backend attempt and report the actual attempt count.
Report premium exhaustion after exactly three failed backend attempts.
Map an accepted premium result to an application result containing tier and actual attempts.
Map exhausted premium requests to a fallback result containing tier and actual attempts without moving retry ownership.
Preserve the standard accepted application result with its one actual attempt.
